_meta.title: Kansai-TD trunk-line voltage — external validation (aggregate only)
_meta.ground_truth: 関西電力送配電 「154kV以上 送電線空容量一覧」
_meta.license_note: Ground-truth is publicly disclosed but All-Rights-Reserved (no redistribution). Raw per-line values are NOT published here; only aggregate agreement metrics are reported, mirroring the TEPCO per-line-flow methodology (source-at-rest, aggregates-only).
_meta.method: Published model line voltage class (docs/data/lines_all.geojson, _voltage_kv) joined to the Kansai-TD disclosure by EXACT line name; voltage class compared. Per-line ratings (設備容量/運用容量) were used privately as ground truth and are not reproduced.

interpretation: Second authoritative external validation after TEPCO per-line flows — this one on a different dimension (line voltage class), against a different utility (Kansai).
Model voltage-class assignment (OSM-derived) matches the utility's official trunk-line disclosure on 37 of 38 named >=154 kV lines (97%).
Future work: model BRANCH thermal ratings are keyed to bus indices, not line names; a name<->BRANCH join is needed to also validate synthetic line ratings against the authoritative 設備容量.
